segments.thag3.10:1.1: “Ahu tuyhaṃ pure saddhā, sā te ajja na vijjati;
segments.thag3.10:1.3: Yaṃ tuyhaṃ tuyhamevetaṃ, natthi duccaritaṃ mama.
segments.thag3.10:2.1: “Aniccā hi calā saddā, evaṃ diṭṭhā hi sā mayā;
segments.thag3.10:2.3: Rajjantipi virajjanti, tattha kiṃ jiyyate muni.
segments.thag3.10:3.1: “Paccati munino bhattaṃ, thokaṃ thokaṃ kule kule;

lines: “Sace mama paccaye na gaṇhatha, kathaṃ tumhe yāpethā”ti evaṃ mā cintayīti dassento “paccatī”ti gāthamāha.
Tassattho munino pabbajitassa bhattaṃ nāma kule kule anugharaṃ divase divase thokaṃ thokaṃ paccate, na ca tuyhaṃ eva gehe.

Piṇḍikāya carissāmi, atthi jaṅghabalaṃ mamāti atthi me jaṅghabalaṃ, nāhaṃ obhaggajaṅgho na khañjo na ca pādarogī, tasmā piṇḍikāya missakabhikkhāya carissāmi,“yathāpi bhamaro pupphan”tiādinā (dha. pa.49; netti.123) satthārā vuttanayena piṇḍāya caritvā yāpessāmīti dasseti.
